_doc: The single register of everything that is compiled only into the Diagnostic Build (or may graduate out of it). kind 'dx' = a DIAGNOSTIC: measurement, test or reporting code with no user-facing function (stress, Check, sweeps...). kind 'fx' = a FEATURE that is still incubating behind the Diagnostic Build flag and is meant to graduate to the release or be dropped (experimental meter settings, rate/speed toggles...). Each converted feature gets a macro TAU_DX_<NAME> / TAU_FX_<NAME> in the generated fw/diag_features.h that defaults to TAU_DIAGNOSTIC (so the default Diagnostic Build is byte-identical) and can be overridden per build: DIAG_DROP=a,b removes features from a Diagnostic Build, FEATURES_ON=a puts an fx into any build (graduation). 'converted': false entries are classified but their code still hangs off TAU_DIAGNOSTIC directly. Generated header: python3 tools/gen_diag_features.py; checked by make test-host.
